propositions: Baseline description, status, and priority fields must be stored in normalized scalar form (ADF text, Jira name strings) rather than vendor dicts to reduce serialized size by approximately 66% while maintaining equivalence in live field comparison.

Assignee field must remain as a raw vendor dict with all identity forms intact to preserve inbound-direction suppression logic and prevent local-wins from overwriting concurrent remote assignee edits.
The pre-A3 reader must accept both scalar and vendor-dict shapes to enable rollback without denormalization, relying on the existing dual-shape inbound mapper seam.

The full-corpus oracle must demonstrate zero mutation deltas (exact fields/conflicts/dropped outcomes) between raw and normalized baselines under both current and pre-A3 code paths, with at least 50% serialized-byte reduction.
All three assignee identity forms (email, accountId, displayName) must preserve their baseline dict structure and inbound suppression behavior across baseline normalization passes.
